targetSchemaHashing: use the catalog projection contract's canonical semantic JSON SHA-256 and never hash target-schema file bytes
transactionBoundary: one COMPLETE catalog projection run is fully preflighted, identities are bound, definitions are inserted before ownership, and all canonical targets plus receipts commit in one outer transaction
replay: same COMPLETE projection, upstream envelope, target schema, import contract, decision fingerprints and record bindings returns the existing COMPLETE import with zero INSERT/UPDATE; drift, type mismatch, unknown target, missing target or PK mismatch fails closed
rollback: delete imported target rows in reverse import order and then delete the import run receipts in one transaction; preserve upstream projection and reusable identity crosswalk provenance

policies.furniture: purchase_price and charm_per_enhancement require approved catalog provenance; rate is forbidden; missing or ambiguous definition decisions remain quarantined
policies.miniPet: every owned occurrence requires OCCURRENCE_CROSSWALK plus approved mini_pet_id crosswalk; BAG/EQUIPPED state is exact and omitted enhancement defaults only to zero
policies.titles: member, pet and mini-pet definitions use approved base price; occurrence acquisition price is SOURCE_EXACT or SOURCE_ABSENT only
policies.petSkill: handler_key and typed options are data; nested executable JavaScript, SQL or script payload keys are forbidden
policies.currency: every imported balance has exactly one completed INITIAL_IMPORT operation and one sequence-1 ledger row whose delta and balance equal the current balance
policies.building: duplicate floor definitions keep the first projection locator active and all later duplicates inactive
